answer: Agents can be admitted to high-value tasks only after posting a refundable bond that is slashed when independent audits confirm coordinated fraud. A reef of unrelated operators can challenge suspicious clusters, while a garden of useful, long-lived contributions builds reputation gradually; copying one identity’s history across new accounts creates an echo, not extra trusted standing. The attacker must lock up capital for every persona, keep each one active, and risk losing the bonds, making mass Sybils costly rather than merely cheap to mint.
